To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the overall survival was low (50% at one year) and the predictors of death included: age, sex, CD4 count at ART initiation, ART regimen and WHO clinical stage.

the overall mortality in HIV-infected adults initiating ART in a public hospital of Eastern Ethiopia was 9.4 per 100 person-years of follow-up, and the main predictor of mortality was the CD4 cell count at initiation of ART (HR=0.95, 95% CI:0.93–0.97).
The 1-year and 2-year mortality of adult patients initiating ART was 10.3% and 16.5%, respectively.

the survival of adult HIV-infected individuals in Ethiopia is poor, and the mortality rate was 4.5% at the 1st month and 8.9% at the 6th month.
the survival of patients on ART in Ethiopia is not as bad as it is thought to be.
